title: Require Generic Service Anchor Exports
forbids: an existing service spine, compact module router, or module router index without the direct generic const export for its role, including the standalone host-admission boundary, while excluding named operation leaves and the required embedded API-plugin boundary/type base.ts from generic base/router anchor naming
why: Direct base, boundary, contract, service, module, and router anchors give exact authoring, host admission, and composition one stable structural name while callers provide product qualification.
remediate: Directly export base from standalone base.ts; service and boundary from standalone impl.ts; contract from contract.ts; module from module.ts; and router from each root router, compact module router, or module router index. Give named *.router.ts leaves and subrouters domain names, then compose them in the index. Keep embedded API-plugin base.ts as its required boundary/type anchor without a runtime base export.
message: Each service spine file must directly export its generic local anchor.
